projectDescription: SCPN-FUSION-CORE linear reduced-MHD paper evidence manifest.

claim_boundary.scope: linear resistive reduced MHD in a Harris slab and a periodic cylinder
claim_boundary.misses: cylinder tearing slope (explained by the follow-up scan) and the negative-Delta-prime Harris root (open; not convergent under refinement)
claim_boundary.excluded: toroidal 1/R physics, shaped equilibria, nonlinear MHD

linear_mhd_reduced_model_acceptance.json.packaging_transform: seven structured Tier-0 fields added first; scientific payload unchanged

linear_mhd_miss_study.json.packaging_transform: seven structured Tier-0 fields added first; scientific payload unchanged

src/scpn_fusion/core/linear_mhd_1d.py.role: Hermite-element slab and cylinder eigenproblem, growth rate

src/scpn_fusion/core/linear_mhd_delta_pr.role: independent shooting of the stability index

src/scpn_fusion/core/linear_mhd_spectrum.role: dense QZ and verified shift-and-invert search

validation/linear_mhd_miss_study.py.role: follow-up study of the two misses, dense QZ at every solve

linear_mhd_reduced_model_acceptance.json.role: nine fixed acceptance criteria, seven passed

linear_mhd_miss_study.json.role: follow-up study: slope to eta 1e-10, Harris root by grid
